title: Sheep eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass ground -->
  <rect x="10" y="78" width="80" height="12" rx="4" fill="#4caf50"/>
  <rect x="10" y="82" width="80" height="8" rx="3" fill="#66bb6a"/>

  <!-- sheep legs -->
  <rect x="32" y="70" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#e0d6c8"/>
  <rect x="46" y="70" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#d4c8b8"/>
  <rect x="58" y="70" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#e0d6c8"/>
  <rect x="68" y="70" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#d4c8b8"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="32" y="80" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8d6e63"/>
  <rect x="46" y="80" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#7b5e56"/>
  <rect x="58" y="80" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8d6e63"/>
  <rect x="68" y="80" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#7b5e56"/>

  <!-- fluffy body -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="58" r="16" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="55" r="15" fill="#ede5d8"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="52" r="12" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="58" r="12" fill="#f0ebe0"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="13" fill="#faf6ee"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="10" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="10" fill="#ede5d8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="11" fill="#faf6ee"/>

  <!-- neck fluff -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="45" r="9" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="50" r="7" fill="#ede5d8"/>

  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="40" rx="11" ry="12" fill="#3d2b1f"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="33" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#3d2b1f" transform="rotate(-20 66 33)"/>
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="33" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#3d2b1f" transform="rotate(20 86 33)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="33" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#c88a7a" transform="rotate(-20 66 33)"/>
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="33" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#c88a7a" transform="rotate(20 86 33)"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="81" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="72.8" cy="37.2" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="81.8" cy="37.2" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="45" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#c88a7a"/>

  <!-- snack: carrot in mouth -->
  <rect x="78" y="46" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ff9800" transform="rotate(-15 78 46)"/>
  <rect x="90" y="42" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4caf50" transform="rotate(-30 90 42)"/>
  <rect x="89" y="47" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4caf50" transform="rotate(-5 89 47)"/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="52" r="5" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="50" r="3" fill="#faf6ee"/>
</svg>
